item.title: Kingsbury wins dual moguls gold; Team Canada wraps men's hockey round robin
item.description: MILAN — Canada claimed its long-awaited first gold medal of the Milan Cortina Olympics, as the men's hockey team delivered a lopsided win and pairs skaters edged a promising start on Day 9 of the Games.

item.title: How a day of chaos and heartache unspooled in Tumbler Ridge
item.description: Nothing is too far apart in tiny Tumbler Ridge, B.C., and there was a well-worn path between the local RCMP detachment and the nondescript brown timber home on Fellers Avenue, less than a kilometre away.

item.title: Wembanyama’s opening-tip intensity, and how yet another NBA All-Star format may have clicked
item.description: INGLEWOOD, Calif. (AP) — Victor Wembanyama brought the energy from opening tip of the NBA All-Star Game , and it proved infectious.

item.title: She was denied a legal abortion and sent to prison over an illegal one. Now she tells her story
item.description: LUSAKA, Zambia (AP) — She says she was let down at every step. By a partner who abandoned her when she was pregnant. By a health service that denied her a legal abortion .

item.title: Morikawa birdies 18th to win Pebble Beach, ends more than 2-year drought
item.description: PEBBLE BEACH, Calif. (AP) — Collin Morikawa had gone 28 months since his last win, and he was reminded Sunday at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-am why it's never easy.

item.title: Anthony Edwards claims MVP award, leads Stars to tourney win in an entertaining NBA All-Star Game
item.description: INGLEWOOD, Calif. (AP) — Anthony Edwards has said it boldly and confidently for years. He intends to be the best basketball player in the world.

item.title: 'Adolescence' and 'Train Dreams' win top prizes at Film Independent Spirit Awards
item.description: Clint Bentley's lyrical Denis Johnson adaptation “Train Dreams " won the top film award at the Film Independent Spirit Awards on Sunday in Los Angeles, while “Adolescence” dominated the television categories. Both were released on Netflix.

item.description: Express gains weekend split with 4-2 win Sunday at Tom Forsyth Memorial Arena

item.title: Police tape down in Tumbler Ridge as shooting victim is honoured 14,000 km away
item.description: TUMBLER RIDGE — On a cold grey morning, residents of Tumbler Ridge, B.C., made their way to their churches' first Sunday services since the recent shootings in the tiny community in which nine people died.

item.title: Celtics star Jaylen Brown disputes Beverly Hills' claims about his event that was shut down
item.description: INGLEWOOD, Calif. (AP) — Boston Celtics star Jaylen Brown disputed the City of Beverly Hills' claims after an event he hosted on the eve of the NBA All-Star Game was shut down because the city said it lacked a permit.
